# unifi_wlan_group (Resource)

The `unifi_wlan_group` resource manages a WLAN group in the UniFi controller.

WLAN groups organize wireless networks so they can be assigned together to access points. WLANs reference a WLAN group by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A WLAN group that wireless networks can be assigned to.
resource "unifi_wlan_group" "guest" {
  name = "guest-group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the WLAN group (1-128 characters).

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_wlan_group.guest 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_wlan_group.guest another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
